prompt_text: Easiest donor management software to use
response_text:
If you want the **easiest donor management software to use**, the strongest candidates from the results are **Givebutter** and **Zeffy**. Givebutter explicitly describes itself as the “**easiest-to-use nonprofit CRM**,” and G2 ranks **Zeffy** as **#1 in ease of use** among free donor management tools.[1][2]

A quick practical take:

| Software | Why it stands out for ease of use | Best fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Givebutter** | User-friendly donor management with integrated marketing and engagement tools; supports filters, tags, sorting, and live search for quick donor lookup.[1] | Nonprofits that want an all-in-one, easy interface |
| **Zeffy** | G2 users describe it as free and easy to use; it is ranked **1st easiest to use** in the free donor management category.[2] | Small nonprofits wanting free and simple software |
| **DonorPerfect** | Described as fast, cloud-based, accessible anywhere, and “easy enough for new staff to use comfortably.”[3] | Teams that want a more established platform with solid usability |
| **DonorDock** | Bloomerang highlights it as simple, with straightforward setup and easier donor stewardship/communication.[6] | Organizations prioritizing simplicity over advanced complexity |

If you want the *single easiest option based on the results*, **Zeffy** has the clearest third-party ease-of-use signal because G2 ranks it **first for ease of use**.[2] If you want the *easiest all-around nonprofit CRM experience with integrated tools*, **Givebutter** is the better pick from the provided sources.[1]

If you want, I can also narrow this down by **free vs paid**, **small nonprofit vs growing team**, or **best for donor tracking only vs full fundraising CRM**.
